title: Consumer Rights & Unfair Trade Practices
summary: Protects consumers against false warranties, misleading advertisements, defective products, and refusal to refund or replace within specified terms.
key_rights: Right to be protected against marketing of hazardous goods
Right to be informed about quality, quantity, potency, purity, and price
Right to seek redressal against unfair trade practices

title: Tenant Rights & Eviction Notice Requirements
act_or_law: Model Tenancy Act & State Rent Control Acts
summary: Mandates written rental agreements, caps security deposit, prohibits landlord from cutting off essential services (water, electricity), and requires minimum 30 days notice for eviction.
key_rights: Landlord cannot cut off water or electricity supply under any dispute
Eviction requires valid legal grounds and written notice
Security deposit return within 30 days of tenancy end

title: Employee Wage Payment & Termination Rights
act_or_law: Payment of Wages Act & Industrial Employment Regulations
summary: Requires timely payment of earned salary by 7th to 10th of following month. Prohibits illegal wage deductions and requires 1 month notice or pay in lieu for termination.
key_rights: Right to receive full earned wages without unauthorized deductions
Right to written termination notice or salary in lieu
Right to severance pay for formal employment exceeding 1 year

title: Digital Personal Data & Privacy Protection
summary: Establishes right to data privacy, right to withdraw consent, right to correction/erasure of personal data, and mandates notification of data breaches.
key_rights: Right to obtain summary of personal data being processed
Right to request deletion of personal data
Right to file grievance with Data Protection Board

title: Enforceability of Contracts & Free Consent
summary: All agreements are contracts if made by free consent of parties competent to contract for lawful consideration. Consent induced by coercion, undue influence, or fraud is voidable.
key_rights: Agreement without free consent is voidable at option of aggrieved party
Minors cannot enter binding financial contracts
Unlawful terms inside a contract are null and void
